scope: Independent review of the actual completed scratch22 source preparation and its non-executable canonical request. No compiler, native build, module, guest, application or acceptance release follows from this record.

terminal.stderr: Only /usr/bin/time verbose accounting; no preparation error output.

request.canonical_validation_evidence: The actual producer log reaches canonical-input-verification and canonical-owner-validated, and completed stdout reports the adapter's second canonical owner/request check PASS. The reviewer checks these exact authenticated execution records and current small consumer hashes; the reviewer does not rerun BuildOwner.validate or rehash the complete source corpus.

shared_evidence.method: For every complete-log shared row, verify the manifest SHA256 equals its authenticated pre-materialization SHA256. For that path in all six retained roots and scratch22, compare live regular-file device/inode/mode/size/mtime_ns with the logged authenticated snapshot and require nlink=7. The stdout shared path list must exactly equal the complete-log list, with no duplicate root.
shared_evidence.producer_verification: The accepted actual preparation ran its complete six-root source admission, materialization shared-input checks, two post-materialization checks and canonical manifest/driver/owner verification before terminal success.

capacity.note: The producer's 333,638,837-byte preflight budget includes all private materialized blobs as well as private retained evidence, metadata/IHK copies and overhead. It supersedes the earlier review's 86,430,585-byte partial-copy estimate; both are below available headroom.

independent_check.profile: Ordinary Python, CPU affinity 0, 120-second timeout, shared 2-GiB RSS planning share, no virtual-AS cap because Git maps its existing pack; no root, Docker, compiler, build, guest, network or execution mutation.
independent_check.result: Exit 0. All exact release/controller, terminal/log/stdout/status, request/manifest/consumer, Git index/tree/file-set, fourteen changed-blob, 3402 shared metadata-path, empty-directory, lease/exclusion-absence and backup checks pass.
independent_check.preserved_harness_failure: The initial read-only review harness assumed ihk_overlay_path_sha256 by appending _sha256 to every path field and raised KeyError after request/manifest checks. The production schema correctly uses ihk_overlay_sha256. One bounded correction supplied explicit path-to-hash-key mappings; the complete review then passed. No preparation source or artifact was changed.

next_authorized_scope: Dispatcher may checkpoint/fetch the completed preparation and this review, then prepare and independently review a fresh one-shot build release against these exact artifacts. This review does not approve that build release or its future resource/process/container bindings.
